## API

Everything below is imported from `@nanahoshi/mona-ui/chart`. Each name links to its reference page, with every input, output, property and method.

| Name | Kind | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| [`WaterfallSeriesComponent`](/api/chart/WaterfallSeriesComponent) | Component | Renders financial cash-flow and contribution movements with positive delta increases, negative delta decreases, zero-change neutral bars, intermediate subtotals, and cumulative grand totals. |
| [`BarSeriesComponent`](/api/chart/BarSeriesComponent) | Component | Renders a Cartesian bar series supporting standalone bars, grouped slots, stacked segments, and 100% normalized stacks. |
| [`RangeBarSeriesComponent`](/api/chart/RangeBarSeriesComponent) | Component | Renders floating Cartesian range bars spanning between a lower value and an upper value (e.g. min/max temperatures, price spans, or SLA tolerances). |
| [`ChartWaterfallLabelTemplateDirective`](/api/chart/ChartWaterfallLabelTemplateDirective) | Directive |  |
